response:
Only Finance Office budget-setting messages and increases or decreases affect the total. There are no withdrawal messages in the records.

Applying all budget updates in order gives these checkpoints:

| Through record | Budget |
|---|---:|
| #0400 | $1,169K |
| #0800 | $2,652K |
| #1200 | $2,235K |
| #1600 | $2,392K |

The initial budget of $1,080K plus net changes of $1,312K leaves **$2,392K**.

ANSWER: $2392K
